load_data: load ImageNet train and test data loaders with augmentation and normalization from a dataset path
create_train_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader for ImageNet training data with random crop, flip, and normalization transforms
create_test_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader for ImageNet validation data with resize, center crop, and normalization transforms
review_load_data: review the load_data function to understand ImageNet data loading with train and test split configuration
refactor_load_data: refactor the load_data function to support custom transform pipelines or different dataset paths
